name: Turn a brake back on: drugs that reactivate the PP2A phosphatase
author: Jude Gomila
message: Editing pass: every TL;DR and summary stands alone

fields.before: "Cells have an enzyme that removes the growth signals cancer relies on. Cancers switch it off. Drugs that switch it back on are an unusual and largely untried approach."
fields.after: "Cells have an enzyme, PP2A, that removes the growth signals cancer relies on. Cancers switch it off. Drugs that switch it back on are an unusual and largely untried approach."
